headline: Every tub of cheese checked, not a sample.
label: #FFFFFF
heroLede: That's Amore makes fresh Italian-style cheeses in Thomastown, from bocconcini and mozzarella to ricotta, burrata and buffalo milk cheeses, and is expanding the site with new cold storage, new automation and a research lab. New automation is the easiest place to build checks in. This is what a camera check could look like on a fresh cheese line, shown here with tubs. We would match it to your own packs. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every tub has its lid on, seated flat, with the seal intact underneath where it can be seen. Fresh cheese in brine leaks fast through a lifted lid.
labelLede: Cow's milk bocconcini and buffalo mozzarella can look the same through a lid. The camera checks every tub carries the right label for the cheese inside, straight and intact, so the claim on the pack is true.
codeLede: Fresh cheese has a short use-by window, so the date has to be right and readable on every tub. The system reads the printed date and batch code and compares them with the product and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Glove pieces, lid offcuts and loose machine parts can end up close to the line. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a case.
